gui.lucariomod.picker.title: Lucario Morph
gui.lucariomod.consent.title: Lucario Morph — morph sync
gui.lucariomod.consent.body: Morph sync lets other players with the mod see your Lucario/Riolu even on servers WITHOUT the mod. While it is enabled, your morph is published to a sync service together with your player UUID, and the service is polled every few seconds for the morphs of the players on your server. Nothing is sent in singleplayer/LAN. You can change this later in the settings (Mod Menu → Lucario Morph → Config), and you can also run your own mirror.
gui.lucariomod.config.title: Lucario Morph settings
lucariomod.cmd.unknown: Unknown variant. Press Tab to see the list (e.g.: /lucario captain, /lucario captain shiny, /lucario mega). To become a normal player again: /lucario off.
lucariomod.cmd.normal: You are a normal player again. (Morph back: /lucario)
lucariomod.auth.offline_server: This server does not verify Minecraft accounts, so morph sync is disabled here.
lucariomod.auth.failed: Could not protect your morph record (%s). Retrying automatically: 2 attempts in 30 seconds, 2 in a minute, then every 5 minutes.
lucariomod.auth.protected: Morph record protected (%s mirror(s)). The token is stored in the config: if you delete it, it will be re-issued automatically.
lucariomod.dance.unavailable: This variant has no dance animation.
lucariomod.dance.started: Dancing! Press the key again to stop.
